milestones.outcome: A durable application-wide channel preference selects eligible BPR updates and preserves exact package and install authority.
milestones.boundary: Hand back the locally verified update-channel feature without publishing or replacing any installed copy.
exit_criteria: Stable only is the default for existing and new update settings, and both choices persist.
The Settings course reaches the shipped updater composition and offers published compatible RCs or stable releases according to the selected channel.
Channel changes invalidate stale checks and staging, and install refresh preserves candidate and native package identity.
